title: citrus × aurantium subsp. khatta
intro: Citrus × aurantium subsp. khatta, commonly known as Khatta or Sour Orange, is a subspecies of the bitter orange tree, known for its unique properties and wide range of uses. The health benefits of Khatta include its ability to aid in digestion, relieve symptoms of indigestion and nausea, and exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Khatta include its use as an antiemetic, antidiarrheal, and antiseptic agent, making it useful in traditional medicine for treating various gastrointestinal issues. The bioactive constituents of Khatta include limonoids, flavonoids, and coumarins, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic properties.
